examples.japanese: {恋人|こいびと}と{別|わか}れた。
examples.english: I broke up with my boyfriend/girlfriend.

examples.japanese: {恋人|こいびと}と{旅行|りょこう}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go on a trip with one's lover.

examples.japanese: {恋人|こいびと}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}にプレゼントを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a present for my boyfriend's/girlfriend's birthday.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}の{時|とき}に{初|はじ}めて{恋人|こいびと}ができて、{毎日|まいにち}{一緒|いっしょ}に{帰|かえ}っていた。
examples.english: When I was in high school, I got my first boyfriend/girlfriend, and we used to walk home together every day.

notes:
{恋人|こいびと} is a romantic partner.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {恋人|こいびと}ができる (to get a boyfriend/girlfriend)
- {恋人|こいびと}と{別|わか}れる (to break up)
- {恋人|こいびと}{同士|どうし} (as lovers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {恋人|こいびと}: romantic partner (literary)
- {彼氏|かれし}/{彼女|かのじょ}: boyfriend/girlfriend (casual)
- パートナー: partner (gender-neutral)
